meta.genre: HD-2D Turn-Based JRPG (Single-Player Adaptation of Final Fantasy Brave Exvius Arc 1 'Lapis')

keyArt.title: Official Complete Guide + Setting Material Collection Cover

coreSystems.name: Action Timeline
coreSystems.summary: Displays upcoming turn order for allies and enemies at the top of the screen, allowing players to plan buffs, heals, and Stagger breaks before enemy turns.

coreSystems.name: Stagger & Devastating Attack Cancel
coreSystems.summary: Every enemy has a Stagger gauge beneath its HP bar. Hitting elemental or physical weaknesses triples Stagger damage. Depleting the gauge cancels any charging Devastating Attack, delays the enemy's turn, and increases damage taken.

coreSystems.name: Sweeping Stagger, Extra Phase & Last Resonance
coreSystems.summary: When all enemies in an encounter are staggered simultaneously, Sweeping Stagger triggers an Extra Phase (bonus action for every party member) followed by Resonance / Last Resonance finishers.

coreSystems.name: Visions, Mastery Ranks (MRP) & AP
coreSystems.summary: Characters equip crystallized Visions of classic Final Fantasy heroes. Fighting earns MRP to raise Mastery Ranks and unlock active/passive abilities equipped via Ability Points (AP). Magicite Shards (Tier 1), Magicite (Tier 2), and Magicite Crysts (Tier 3) awaken Visions.

coreSystems.name: Summoning Espers
coreSystems.summary: Fina summons Espers onto the battlefield as independent allies for 3 turns (one active at a time) before the Esper unleashes its signature finishing move. Each Esper also provides a 'Break the Limit' passive raising the damage cap to 99,999.

coreSystems.name: Gold Pots & Cactuar MRP Grinding
coreSystems.summary: Gold Pots in dungeons trade items (usually an Ether) for massive MRP to level unused Visions. Cactuars and Gigantuars (southwest Gronoa and outside Dragon's Maw) are best defeated using Noctis's Barrage (guaranteed hit). Switching to Expert difficulty before these encounters grants a 1.5x MRP multiplier.

caveMasters.name: Marauder
caveMasters.strategy: Single-target physical boss; stagger with Wind before Thwack lands.

caveMasters.name: Shoggoth
caveMasters.strategy: Immune to physical attacks. Use Earth or Water magic only, and keep Shell up against Lightning magic.

caveMasters.name: Rukh
caveMasters.strategy: Immune to Earth. Use Dispel on Mighty Guard/Scatter Feathers and Light Veil to block Petrifying Gaze.

caveMasters.name: Mindflayer
caveMasters.strategy: Defeat the 2 Mind Elementals (Lv. 27, 1,800 HP, Weak: Fire) first so every break on Mindflayer is a Sweeping Stagger.

caveMasters.name: Gogmagog
caveMasters.strategy: Heavy physical bruiser. Keep Protect up and Dispel its +50% Bravery buff.

caveMasters.name: Pyroviper
caveMasters.strategy: Immune to Fire; acts twice per turn. Maintain both Protect and Shell.

caveMasters.name: Salome
caveMasters.strategy: Halves Earth; acts twice per turn. Cast Fina's Light Veil before Allure to prevent party-wide Charm.

caveMasters.name: Jotunn
caveMasters.strategy: Immune to Ice. Revenge Blast scales with missing HP—save Stagger break for low HP.

caveMasters.name: Malboro Varietas
caveMasters.strategy: Immune to all status ailments. Use Light Veil before Bad Breath and burst down with Fire.

caveMasters.name: Tartarosaurus
caveMasters.strategy: Halves Earth. Uses powerful skills more frequently at low HP; save Resonance for the final phase.

caveMasters.name: Catacumba
caveMasters.strategy: Bone Toss deals 99% current HP; Disaster inflicts Doom (3-turn countdown). Open with heavy burst to lower its HP quickly.

caveMasters.name: Necromonarch
caveMasters.strategy: Counters magic attacks of its elemental weakness—use physical Fire/Light skills (e.g., Rain/Clive/Cecil) to outpace its 20% HP Rejuvenate.

caveMasters.name: Humbaba
caveMasters.strategy: Bring two healers and Light Veil for Ruthless Rampage and Rabid Claw (Confuse/Berserk).

caveMasters.name: Malboro Menace
caveMasters.strategy: Counters after a set number of Fire hits, but loses 1 action on the following turn. Keep Light Veil active before Putrid Breath.

caveMasters.name: Titanoraidos
caveMasters.strategy: Snort permanently removes a party member from battle—always break the Stagger gauge before Snort triggers.
